value_family: strike-aligned (anisotropic) collar: along held at the parent's 2 px, across = A

parent.r0_rebuilt_from: pinned h27-4 solo-d2.8 mask & (Euclidean d_cat > 2 px)

strike_field.method: structure tensor of the catalogue binary mask (smooth sigma 1.0, tensor sigma 3.0)
strike_field.coherence_rule: pixels below coherence 0.3 at their nearest catalogue pixel get no along-strike exemption

reservation.collision_convention: numeric-collision rule applies to isotropic radii only; see ledger/experiment_reservations.json

leakage_canary.sentinel_handling: non-finite and <= -1e30 masked out per band before ranking
leakage_canary.note: Single-feature separability on the known catalogue only; no live-score inference.

catalogue_hide_recover.reason: no fold-clean instrument calibrated for a collar-geometry comparison; never a gate or score

sgmc_control.reason: not a calibrated control for this collar geometry

variants.predicted_change: +0.003 DTI (MODEL; plausible -0.010 to +0.010; not a score)
variants.form_note: h33-h33-2-b2; PRUNE strike-aligned collar across<=4px along<=2px, fixed-count refill; predicted +0.003 DTI MODEL

isotropic_comparator.note: Isotropic count is the comparator; it is not an edit applied to any file.

refill_diagnostics.interpretation: High 'within 3 px of retained' means refills are largely redundant mass (penalty, little fresh kernel credit). It is a property of the inherited refill policy, not of the collar geometry under test; there is no live score behind it.

refill.pool_rule: H19-5 support, footprint, not catalogue, outside the collar, not already kept
refill.ordering: recovered FIFO-BFS thinning visit rank (deterministic tie-break, not a probability)

mechanism_card.hypothesis: R0's isotropic 2 px collar removes across-strike flank mass and along-strike continuation with equal force. Widening the collar to 4 px across strike only, at fixed dot count, should raise DTI if near-catalogue flank dots are predominantly false mass while along-strike continuations are predominantly real unmapped geometry.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Known catalogue pixels are masked pixel-exactly while new-fault truth can sit within 300 m of a known trace, so the collar trades false-positive mass against adjacent true credit. The parent's 2 px collar is direction-free: it removes flank mass and along-strike continuation alike. On a 400 m-spacing survey the positional error that matters is cross-strike, and along-strike continuation of a mapped trace is real (unmapped geometry of existing systems is explicitly scored). This family therefore widens the collar only across strike, holding the parent's 2 px radius along strike, at fixed dot count.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: A dot a few pixels across strike from a mapped trace may be a real parallel strand, a step-over, or the surface expression of a steeply dipping strand whose surface trace is offset from the mapped line; the refill pixels are H19-5 thinning-order picks, which are lithologic contacts or drainage lineaments as often as faults.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.003 DTI (MODEL; plausible -0.010 to +0.010; not a score)
mechanism_card.prediction_decomposition: collar term +0.004 to +0.006 (2632 dots at median 2.8 px across strike removed), refill dilution -0.001 to -0.003 (2632 dots added a median 1.0 px from a retained dot), net +0.003
mechanism_card.refill_confound: 99.5% of the 2632 refill dots sit within 3 px of a retained dot (median 1.00 px), so the fixed-count refill adds mostly penalty, little fresh kernel credit. The removed dots are non-local replacements (median displaced 888 px). Both terms are inherited from the parent lineage's refill policy, not from the collar geometry under test.
mechanism_card.falsifier: A paired, same-week live receipt against R0 with delta <= -0.010 falsifies the across-strike-only collar at this dose; any |delta| < 0.010 is no evidence under the session rule. A monotone decline across A = 4, 5, 6 would additionally reject the dose-response implied by the mechanism.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: Read the removed set as two populations: flank dots at 2-3 px across strike from mapped traces (the predicted false mass) and along-strike continuations beyond mapped tips (which this edit deliberately keeps). Check whether the kept continuations look like real projections of the mapped geometry or like an artefact of the structure-tensor window.
mechanism_card.information_value: Separates 'wider collar pays' from 'along-strike collateral costs' only together with the isotropic rungs; on its own it says whether the across-strike-only collar moves the live score at all.
